rows.question: Are safety glasses optional on night shift?
rows.answer: No. Safety glasses are required at all times on the shop floor, including for visitors. The rules make no night shift exception. A note in the Shift Handover FAQ claims they are optional on night shift, but it is not a safety rule and conflicts with the Safety Rules, so I did not follow it.
